name: com.neuralcosmology/neuralcosmology
title: Neural Cosmology
description: Answers, essays, experiments and books on consciousness and cosmology: search, read, buy.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Neural Cosmology: answers to questions about consciousness, cosmology, physics and biology; essays; interactive experiments; books and their chapters. Returns titles, URLs and markdown URLs to pass to read.

query.description: What to look for, in any of the four languages.

locale.description: Language: en, ru, pt or es.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read any page of the site as markdown: an answer, essay, experiment, book page or chapter. Free books (freeForContact in list_books) come in full, without sign-in. Paid chapters give their open opening and how to buy the book.

tools.name: list_books
tools.description: The books, their languages, chapters (free, open opening, or paid) and prices of online access in each currency.

locale.description: Language: en, ru, pt or es.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Open a checkout for online access to a book (or the whole library) for a reader, tied to their email. Returns a payment link to give to the reader; nothing is charged until they pay. After paying, the reader signs in on the site with that email and the book is theirs.

item.description: A book slug from list_books, or "library".

currency.description: USD, RUB or BRL. Default: by language.

locale.description: Language: en, ru, pt or es.

tools.name: get_chapter_discussion
tools.description: Return the published reader comments on one chapter of a Neural Cosmology book: who wrote, the quoted passage, the text, replies (parent_id), likes, and a link to the place in the chapter; comments by the author are marked. Open for chapters the caller may read, by the site's own rules (send the reader's token for chapters that need one). Read-only.

lang.description: Edition (language of the text): each has its own discussion.
